title: Minimum XOR Sum of Two Arrays
description: You are given two integer arrays `nums1` and `nums2` of equal length `n`. The XOR sum of the two arrays is `(nums1[0] ^ nums2[0]) + (nums1[1] ^ nums2[1]) + ... + (nums1[n - 1] ^ nums2[n - 1])`. You may rearrange the elements of `nums2` in any order. Return the minimum possible XOR sum after optimally rearranging `nums2`.
hints: Represent the subset of `nums2` indices already matched to the first `i = popcount(mask)` elements of `nums1` as an `n`-bit integer `mask`.
Compute `dp[mask]` over all `2^n` masks by trying each set bit `j` in `mask` as the partner of `nums1[popcount(mask) - 1]`, taking the minimum of `dp[mask ^ (1 << j)] + (nums1[i - 1] ^ nums2[j])`.
